I couldn’t find a “Wiggle & Snug” diaper brand; I think you may mean **Huggies Snug & Dry Size 5**.

Current prices I found:

- **Walmart — Huggies Snug & Dry Size 5, 60 ct:** **$19.97** (33.3¢/diaper). ([walmart.com](https://www.walmart.com/ip/15036922577))  
- **H-E-B — Huggies Snug & Dry Disney Mickey Mouse Big Pack Size 5, 62 ct:** **$20.47** (33¢/diaper). ([heb.com](https://www.heb.com/product-detail/huggies-snug-amp-dry-disney-mickey-mouse-big-pack-diapers-size-5-over-27-lbs-/790866))  
- **Fleet Farm — Huggies Snug & Dry Big Pack Size 5:** **$15.39 clearance**; regular **$21.99**. ([fleetfarm.com](https://www.fleetfarm.com/detail/huggies-snug-dry-big-pack-diapers-size-5/0000000378146))  

So, the **big pack is roughly $20–$22 normally**, depending on the store; there may be clearance or local pricing.
